function.name: game_functions_solve_jigsaw
function.description: Generate solution for a given jigsaw puzzle image. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

puzzle_image.description: The image file of the jigsaw puzzle.

pieces_count.description: Number of pieces in the jigsaw puzzle.

solve_method.description: Method to be used to solve the puzzle. Default is brute_force.

message.content: I can help you solve a jigsaw puzzle, but I don’t have a built‑in tool to generate a new puzzle image from scratch. If you have an image you’d like to turn into a puzzle, let me know the file (or a link) and how many pieces you’d like, and I can walk you through creating it or even solve it for you. If you just want a ready‑made puzzle, I can suggest some resources where you can download or print one. Let me know what you’d prefer!
